reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — resolved sink value is http://<user_input>/v1 where host = request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest'). Although isNonPublicAddress() performs DNS resolution validation, it only checks for loopback/site/local/link-local/any-local addresses and does not prevent access to cloud metadata services, staging environments, or other internal resources that aren't classified as 'non-public'. The user-controlled host parameter flows directly to the URL construction at line 43, enabling SSRF attacks despite the incomplete mitigation.
